title: Study: only ~3% of Polymarket accounts drove most price discovery in 2023-2025, suggesting market accuracy comes from an informed minority, not crowd wisdom (Sam Reynolds/CoinDesk)
summary: Sam Reynolds / CoinDesk: Study: only ~3% of Polymarket accounts drove most price discovery in 2023-2025, suggesting market accuracy comes from an informed minority, not crowd wisdom — Researchers show market accuracy comes from a tiny group of informed traders, not broad participation. … What to know:
